integrity: All stated identities follow from normalized triangular-difference moments and exact rational inversion. A standalone stdlib exact coefficient checker was executed successfully; its finite randomized cases are not substitutes for the analytic proof. The preliminary originality comparison has documented residual risks.
limitations: Nondegenerate Euclidean parallelograms only; two independent normalized area-uniform points; exact initial three even moments. No recovery of arbitrary polygons, quantitative noisy inverse, or minimality among arbitrary measurement triples. Detailed full text of the motivating 2026 preprint was not accessible; residual literature-priority uncertainty.
title: Three even interpoint-distance moments identify every Euclidean parallelogram
